info.name: Google Drive Bridge
info.summary: Connect your Google Drive as a folder in Files, with your own OAuth credentials
Collega il tuo Google Drive come cartella nei File, con le tue credenziali OAuth
info.description: Each user enters the OAuth client of their own Google project, signs in and finds Google Drive as a folder in Files. The files go through an rclone container, either mounted as a folder and shown with External storage (mount mode) or served over WebDAV (webdav mode). Install and update with the install.sh script from the repository.

Ogni utente inserisce il client OAuth del proprio progetto Google, fa login e trova Google Drive come cartella nei File. I file passano da un container rclone, montato come cartella e mostrato con l'Archiviazione esterna (modalità mount) oppure servito via WebDAV (modalità webdav). Installazione e aggiornamento con lo script install.sh del repository.
info.author: Antonello Migliorelli
